item.tib: rma chen pom ra'i gsol kha mchod gzhung 'dod pa kun 'byung
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni mdo smad rma rgyud kyi nye bar mkho ba'i/ byang phyogs sma ru'i ma yul gshen gling gi sngags pa rigs ldan rgyal ba bkra shis dang tshe dbang don 'grub gnyis kyi dad mos kyis tshig gis bskul tshe/ skyang sprul nam rgyal mtshan ming gis me pho stag gi lo 'bras ldan gyi dus su nyi ma lug gi khyim du babs pa'i tshe/(du brtsams) pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/
